name: EPIC 212163872

text.card: A red giant 2,984 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 0.98 solar masses and 9.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,829 K at its surface.
